attributes.caveat: Attributes are associations measured on logged traces. An attribute may travel with failure because it causes it, because a common factor causes both, or because harder tasks provoke it.
attributes.narrative: Of 16 run(s) with 4 failure(s), the strongest association is that the run contains a step annotated weak or bad: within the same task, such runs fail 67% more often (raw 67% of 6 versus 0% of 10). This is an association, not a cause. 3 other attribute(s) also separate.

attributes_joint.method: ridge-penalised logistic regression (IRLS, fixed iteration cap, deterministic)
attributes_joint.caveat: Coefficients control for the other measured attributes only, and not for task difficulty. They remain associations.
attributes_joint.narrative: Holding the other 5 attribute(s) fixed, the run contains a step annotated weak or bad raises the odds of failure most (odds ratio 3.6741). With 16 run(s) and 7 parameter(s) this fit is indicative only — it wants about 35 runs to be read confidently.
